verdict.rationale: dLocal documents a Checkout Redirect option that lets merchants 'process payments safely and simply with a ready-to-use design and front end,' which is a vendor-hosted checkout that removes the need to build a payment UI. Hosted Payment Links, which need no integration, reinforce that dLocal offers hosted payment pages. The evidence is only a one-line mention, though, with no detail on redirect flow mechanics or optimization. missing for 10: evidence the page is conversion-optimized, in-depth Checkout Redirect docs (redirect/return URL flow, customization, supported methods), independent or hands-on corroboration.
